arxiv-2109-02786.title: Deep SIMBAD: Active Landmark-based Self-localization Using Ranking -based Scene Descriptor
arxiv-2109-02786.creator: Tanaka Kanji
arxiv-2109-02786.description: Abstract Landmark-based robot self-localization has recently garnered interest as a highly-compressive domain-invariant approach for performing visual place recognition (VPR) across domains (e.g., time of day, weather, and season). However, landmark-based self-localization can be an ill-posed problem for a passive observer (e.g., manual robot control), as many viewpoints may not provide an effective landmark view.

arxiv-2210-01122.title: BIASeD: Bringing Irrationality into Automated System Design
arxiv-2210-01122.creator: Aditya Gulati aditya@ellisalicante.org
arxiv-2210-01122.description: Abstract Human perception, memory and decision-making are impacted by tens of cognitive biases and heuristics that influence our actions and decisions. Despite the pervasiveness of such biases, they are generally not leveraged by today’s Artificial Intelligence (AI) systems that model human behavior and interact with humans.

arxiv-2212-01450.title: Crowd Density Estimation using Imperfect Labels
arxiv-2212-01450.creator: Muhammad Asif Khan, Hamid Menouar, Ridha Hamila
arxiv-2212-01450.description: Abstract Density estimation is one of the most widely used methods for crowd counting in which a deep learning model learns from head-annotated crowd images to estimate crowd density in unseen images. Typically, the learning performance of the model is highly impacted by the accuracy of the annotations and inaccurate annotations may lead to localization and counting errors during prediction.

arxiv-2305-05190.title: Electric field induced Mott-insulator to metal transition and memristive behaviour in epitaxial V 2 O 3 thin film
arxiv-2305-05190.creator: Binoy Krishna De 1 , V. G. Sathe 1 , S. B. Roy 1,2
arxiv-2305-05190.description: Abstract We report an isothermal electric field-induced first order phase transition from Mott-insulator to the metallic state in the epitaxial thin film of V 2 O 3 in the temperature regime below its Mott transition temperature ≈ \approx 180 K.

arxiv-2312-17070.title: Swapping Floquet time crystal
arxiv-2312-17070.creator: Roberto Gargiulo, Gianluca Passarelli, Procolo Lucignano, Angelo Russomanno
arxiv-2312-17070.description: Abstract We propose a Floquet period-doubling time-crystal model based on a disordered interacting long-range spin chain where the periodic swapping of nearby spin couples is applied. This protocol can be applied to systems with any local spin magnitude s s and in principle also to systems with nonspin (fermionic or bosonic) local Hilbert space.

arxiv-2409-07591.title: CAVERNAUTE : a design and manufacturing pipeline of a rigid but foldable indoor airship aerial system for cave exploration
arxiv-2409-07591.creator: Louis Catar, Jorge E. Salas Gordoniz, Ilyass Tabiai, David St-Onge
arxiv-2409-07591.description: Abstract Airships, best recognized for their unique quality of payload/energy ratio, present a fascinating challenge for the field of engineering. Their construction and operation require a delicate balance of materials and rules, making them a compelling object of study. They embody a distinct intersection of physics, design, and innovation, offering a wide array of possibilities for future transportation and exploration.

arxiv-2506-22084.title: Transformers are Graph Neural Networks
arxiv-2506-22084.creator: Chaitanya K. Joshi
arxiv-2506-22084.description: Abstract We establish connections between the Transformer architecture, originally introduced for natural language processing, and Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) for representation learning on graphs. We show how Transformers can be viewed as message passing GNNs operating on fully connected graphs of tokens, where the self-attention mechanism capture the relative importance of all tokens w.r.t.

pmc-10738870.title: READ TO SUCCEED: HOW BOOK CLUBS CAN IMPROVE INTERGENERATIONAL RELATIONS AND FOSTER AGE FRIENDLINESS IN COMMUNITIES
pmc-10738870.creator: Katelyn Frey, Jennifer Sublett, Nikolina Kravljaca, Jennifer Stanley
pmc-10738870.description: Intergenerational programming is recommended to improve age friendliness in communities, but there is little empirical research to support its effectiveness (Canedo-García et al., 2017). This project examined whether a multimodal intergenerational book club challenged age stereotypes and reduced ageism among participants (N=41).

pmc-11380656.title: Enhanced drug delivery with nanocarriers: a comprehensive review of recent advances in breast cancer detection and treatment
pmc-11380656.creator: Ruby Dhiman, Nancy Bazad, Riya Mukherjee, Himanshu, Gunjan, Elcio Leal, Saheem Ahmad, Kirtanjot Kaur, V Samuel Raj, Chung-Ming Chang, Ramendra Pati Pandey
pmc-11380656.description: Breast cancer (BC) remains a leading cause of morbidity and mortality among women worldwide, with triple-negative breast cancer (TNBC) posing significant treatment challenges due to its aggressive phenotype and resistance to conventional therapies. Recent advancements in nanocarrier technology offer promising solutions for enhancing drug delivery, improving bioavailability, and increasing drug accumulation at tumor sites through targeted approaches.

pmc-11413958.title: Multicrystalline informatics: a methodology to advance materials science by unraveling complex phenomena
pmc-11413958.creator: Noritaka Usami, Kentaro Kutsukake, Takuto Kojima, Hiroaki Kudo, Tatsuya Yokoi, Yutaka Ohno
pmc-11413958.description: Multicrystalline materials play a crucial role in our society. However, their microstructure is complicated, and there is no universal approach to achieving high performance. Therefore, a methodology is necessary to answer the fundamental question of how we should design and create microstructures. ‘Multicrystalline informatics’ is an innovative approach that combines experimental, theoretical, computational, and data sciences.

pmc-11709141.title: Decoding the genetic blueprint: regulation of key agricultural traits in sorghum
pmc-11709141.creator: Fangyuan Liu, Baye Wodajo, Peng Xie
pmc-11709141.description: Sorghum, the fifth most important crop globally, thrives in challenging environments such as arid, saline-alkaline, and infertile regions. This remarkable crop, one of the earliest crops domesticated by humans, offers high biomass and stress-specific properties that render it suitable for a variety of uses including food, feed, bioenergy, and biomaterials.

pmc-13092656.description: SummaryBackgroundCytomegalovirus (CMV) is a major unrecognised cause of morbidity and mortality in infants living with HIV. pmc-13272928.creator: Cherith J. Semple, Kairen McCloy, Sharon L. Bingham, Katherine Penney, David Johnston, Jeffrey R. Hanna
pmc-13272928.description: BackgroundGlobally, people with head and neck cancer (HNC) are twice as likely to die by suicide compared to all other cancers.
